svg.title: Utopia Vinyl order and payment snapshot
svg.desc: Current valid orders, checked November 11, 2026 (Toronto time). NT$20,704 in displayed totals across 26 orders: NT$9,560 paid across 12 orders and NT$11,144 awaiting payment across 14 orders. Cancelled and expired orders are excluded. Paid and awaiting-payment totals are reported separately. Uses displayed order totals; estimated month-end combined shipping is not added.
